description: This file defines the RouteInterface interface for the Slim Framework, specifying the methods and properties that route classes must implement, including route invocation strategies, patterns, callables, arguments, middleware, and execution logic.

methods.name: getMethods
methods.description: Returns an array of HTTP methods associated with the route.

methods.name: getCallable
methods.description: Returns the callable associated with the route.

methods.name: getIdentifier
methods.description: Retrieves a unique identifier for the route.

methods.name: getArgument
methods.description: Retrieves a specific argument from the route.

methods.name: getArguments
methods.description: Retrieves all arguments for the route.

methods.name: setArgument
methods.description: Sets a specific argument for the route (deprecated).

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds middleware or callables to the route.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Prepares the route with arguments for execution.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the route, traversing middleware and generating a response.
